summary: Bounded finite-model investigation under the existing NIGHT-COSMOGONY vocabulary, Bool beings and one Unit respect. Reuse the unchanged Residual, NoReduction, SelfMover and OtherMover interpretations; extend their registrations with exact root mover, mover-actuality and act/potency-exclusion evaluations. Five-member incompatible-bundle deletion target: Night actualization, a mover for every moved being, every mover in act, same-respect act/potency exclusion and the restricted actual-mover simple-priority bridge. Single-deletion witnesses respectively: Residual, NoReduction, new NonactualMover, SelfMover, OtherMover. Every deletion is evaluated in one joint interpretation; no models are combined. OtherMover jointly satisfies the Night background and all three assumptions used to force a nonprior distinct actual mover. The first four deletion models also violate that forced conclusion. New Overlap interpretation has the same unpreceded moved potency both actually move itself and have a distinct nonprior actual mover; therefore coverage cannot be advertised as exclusive. New NonactualMover interpretation has a mover for the same moved potency while no mover is in act, rejecting the reading of the first horn as absence of any mover or as absolute causelessness. Model descriptions assert only satisfiability of this encoding, not metaphysical possibility. No source attribution is added, no root premise is discharged, and no minimum-cardinality assertion is made. Focused Lean build of TruthCore.Models.NightActualizationFork passed. The existing finite_models.verify_models gate accepted all six Night registrations, 79 exact closed certificates, with no axioms. Every single-member deletion is thus jointly witnessed; for the incompatible-bundle theorem, combine these witnesses with the separately checked NIGHT-ACTUALIZATION-CORE result. This certifies inclusion-minimality only, not minimum cardinality. The forced-branch conclusion has an omission countermodel for each of its four hypotheses. Supplementary certificates OtherMover.jointRootBackground, Overlap.sameWitnessOverlap and NonactualMover.nonactualMover live in TruthCore.Models.NightActualizationFork. Final integrated build/binding/Comparator/NanoDa remain the coordinator delivery gates.
